ore_candidate_checks.scope: Candidate attempts on controlled solid hosts, before natural terrain, other ores, cavities, fluids, or repeated-coordinate replacement can reduce successful placements.

crystal_checks.scope: Controlled checkerboard air/rock caves and deterministic random selection validate SIZE-unit budgets, full final cube completion, density scaling, upper/lower coverage, support, bounds, empty/fluid rejection, and Nether exclusion.

deepslate_checks.integration: Loaded loot tables, Fortune/Silk Touch, mining properties, aspects/research, furnace/blast furnace and metal purification.

limits: No statistical full-world natural terrain ore/crystal density survey or long exploration run was performed. Actual successful placements depend on host rock, cave geometry, local surface height, biome and random draws.
Reported ore counts are configured candidate attempts per feature/chunk at each density, not a guaranteed number of unique ore blocks.
Crystal attempts and SIZE budgets are control parameters; they do not promise a fixed number of clusters, blocks or dropped essence. The full final cluster can exceed its SIZE budget.
Datagen registry validation is separate from the runtime GameTest server; its server_started=false field is expected.
Validation establishes the current built artifact and controlled runtime behavior; it does not backfill already-generated chunks.
